name: Node.js Universal v1.1
author: consolex1@consolex1.com
description: Universal Node.js egg optimized for fast installation. Supports npm, pnpm and Yarn with automatic package manager detection and lockfile-aware installs.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server

echo "========================================"
echo " Node.js Universal Installer v1.1"
echo "========================================"

echo ""
echo "[NodeJS] Node.js: $(node --version)"
echo "[NodeJS] npm: $(npm --version)"

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
    echo "[NodeJS] No package.json found. Skipping dependency installation."
    exit 0
fi

PACKAGE_MANAGER=""
PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION=""

if node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); process.exit(p.packageManager && p.packageManager.startsWith('pnpm@') ? 0 : 1)"; then
    PACKAGE_MANAGER="pnpm"
    PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').packageManager.split('@')[1]")
elif node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); process.exit(p.packageManager && p.packageManager.startsWith('yarn@') ? 0 : 1)"; then
    PACKAGE_MANAGER="yarn"
    PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').packageManager.split('@')[1]")
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
    PACKAGE_MANAGER="pnpm"
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
    PACKAGE_MANAGER="yarn"
elif [ -f package-lock.json ] || [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
    PACKAGE_MANAGER="npm"
else
    PACKAGE_MANAGER="npm"
fi

echo "[NodeJS] Package manager selected: ${PACKAGE_MANAGER}"

if [ -n "${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" ]; then
    echo "[NodeJS] Requested version: ${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}"
fi

case "${PACKAGE_MANAGER}" in
    pnpm)
        if [ -n "${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" ]; then
            corepack prepare "pnpm@${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" --activate
        fi

        if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            echo "[NodeJS] pnpm-lock.yaml detected."
            echo "[NodeJS] Running pnpm install --frozen-lockfile..."
            corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        else
            echo "[NodeJS] No pnpm lockfile detected."
            echo "[NodeJS] Running pnpm install..."
            corepack pnpm install
        fi

        echo "[NodeJS] Rebuilding native dependencies..."
        corepack pnpm rebuild || true
        ;;

    yarn)
        if [ -n "${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" ]; then
            corepack prepare "yarn@${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" --activate
        fi

        if [[ "${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" == 4.* || "${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" == 3.* || "${PACKAGE_MANAGER_VERSION}" == 2.* ]]; then
            echo "[NodeJS] Yarn Berry detected."
            echo "[NodeJS] Running yarn install --immutable..."
            corepack yarn install --immutable
        elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            echo "[NodeJS] yarn.lock detected."
            echo "[NodeJS] Running yarn install --frozen-lockfile..."
            corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile
        else
            echo "[NodeJS] No Yarn lockfile detected."
            echo "[NodeJS] Running yarn install..."
            corepack yarn install
        fi
        ;;

    npm)
        if [ -f package-lock.json ] || [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
            echo "[NodeJS] npm lockfile detected."
            echo "[NodeJS] Running npm ci..."
            npm ci
        else
            echo "[NodeJS] No npm lockfile detected."
            echo "[NodeJS] Running npm install..."
            npm install
        fi
        ;;

    *)
        echo "[NodeJS] ERROR: Unsupported package manager: ${PACKAGE_MANAGER}"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo ""
echo "========================================"
echo " Installation complete"
echo "========================================"
echo ""
echo "[NodeJS] Node.js: $(node --version)"
echo "[NodeJS] npm: $(npm --version)"
echo ""
echo "[NodeJS] All dependencies installed successfully."
